scenes.title: Opening Music
scenes.summary: Opening music plays over morning preparations inside Feinkost Kolinski in Hamburg.

scenes.title: The Fruit Order
scenes.summary: Pina reviews the weekend fruit order with branch manager Thorsten until the office phone rings.

scenes.title: Sabine Is Coming Today
scenes.summary: Thorsten learns company boss Sabine Kolinski wants to visit today and discovers the staff are outside smoking.

scenes.title: My First Day
scenes.summary: New trainee Titus introduces himself during the outdoor break before Thorsten storms out and sends everyone back to work.

scenes.title: At Checkout Two
scenes.summary: Flora trains nervous Titus to open checkout two, call customers over, and chat politely with regular shopper Frau Buchholz.

scenes.title: Your Tip
scenes.summary: Flora quietly takes two euros from the till as a self-awarded tip and pressures reluctant Titus to accept it.

scenes.title: Go to the Park Today
scenes.summary: Panicking over Sabine's visit, Thorsten asks the camper staying in the back room to take his dog Puffi to the park for the day.

scenes.title: A Photo with the Star
scenes.summary: Security guard Jonas introduces his job, hands out a spare trolley token, and asks actor Fahri for a selfie while mistaking him for someone else.

scenes.title: Beyza Is Here
scenes.summary: Relieved that Sabine sent her assistant Beyza instead, Thorsten welcomes Beyza and secretly vows to ask her out today.

scenes.title: The Cold-Room Door
scenes.summary: Peter calls himself the alpha wolf of the store, shows Titus the walk-in cold room, and panics when the pizza box propping the door vanishes.

scenes.title: Keeping a Cool Head
scenes.summary: Brief musical interlude and Jonas's remark about staying calm and observing.

scenes.title: The Key in the Trolley
scenes.summary: A friendly customer tells Pina his house key is stuck in a shopping trolley, and Pina sends him to Wilhelm for help.

scenes.title: The Numbers Look Bad
scenes.summary: In the office, Beyza confronts Thorsten about the store's poor figures, prompting a flustered Thorsten to summon Pina.

scenes.title: A Cool Scooter
scenes.summary: The grateful customer gives Pina a trolley token and lets her test-ride his electric scooter down the aisle.

scenes.title: Cover the Camera
scenes.summary: Despite being in his trial week, Titus reluctantly stands in front of a shelf to block the new security camera while Peter pockets goods.

scenes.title: Where Does the Money Come From
scenes.summary: Thorsten tries to invite Beyza to dinner just before Pina enters and questions the mysterious fifteen-thousand-euro surplus.

scenes.title: Are the Cameras Running
scenes.summary: Beyza warns Thorsten he could be replaced over continuing stock losses, and Thorsten shoos Pina out to ask Beyza about her evening plans.

scenes.title: You Have a Plan
scenes.summary: Beyza tells Pina she is the only one who knows what she is doing and leaves her number, while Thorsten imagines Beyza likes him.

scenes.title: Not Before Six O'Clock
scenes.summary: At the open checkout, the scooter customer pays Pina and slips her his phone number with a reminder not to call before six.

scenes.title: Those Are My Nuts
scenes.summary: Jonas stops Fahri over an unpaid bag of nuts, escorts him toward the office, and boasts to the camera about his martial-arts throws.

scenes.title: Handsome Thorsten
scenes.summary: Thorsten greets old acquaintance Fahri in the office and brags about running the branch while privately telling the camera he hates him.

scenes.title: It Is on Me
scenes.summary: Thorsten waves off Fahri's stolen nuts, Fahri teases Thorsten until he snaps, and overeager Jonas tackles Fahri to the floor.

scenes.title: End Credits
scenes.summary: Closing music and end credits roll after the scuffle in Thorsten's office.
